_comment: Round-trip cost = 2 x per-side basis points (spread + slippage + fees). Assumptions, 2026-09-28; edit freely, the ledger re-grades on the next pass.
_kalshi: Kalshi uses its own fee formula (kalshi-btc-agent model.kalshi_fee), applied per contract.
_option: Spreads: 2 legs x option_slippage_per_share_per_leg on the way out (entry is the ticket's limit). Held to expiry, value = clip(close - long, 0, short - long).
_dex: Onchain (Coinbase Wallet) swaps: ~0.3% pool fee + slippage per side, estimated.
